statuses.registered: Relevant source family is present in the corpus.
statuses.ruled: At least one operational Methodome rule exists.
statuses.gap: Source support is insufficient for a defensible rule.
statuses.deferred: Intentionally outside the first knowledge release.

domains.notes: Description, association/explanation, prediction and causal distinctions represented; diagnostic/prognostic need deeper domain rules.
Cross-sectional/cohort/case-control recognition plus mixed-method separation.
Strata, PSU/cluster, multistage, weights and finite-population correction represented.
Categorical versus quantitative minimum represented; ordinal/count/time-to-event refinements continue.
Categorical count/proportion summaries and quantitative mean-versus-median decisions by shape/outliers are represented; count/rate and date/time summaries can expand later.
Independent two-sample t, separate-variance handling, paired t, Wilcoxon rank-sum and Wilcoxon signed-rank decision rules are represented.
One-way ANOVA and Kruskal-Wallis draft rules added.
Expected-count checks represented.
NIST and STAT 200 provide direct small-sample support.
Linear quantitative association rule and diagnostics represented.
Corpus mentions Spearman but current extraction does not yet support a general ordinal/monotonic decision rule.
LINE assumptions, residual diagnostics and multicollinearity represented.

Binary-response eligibility plus structure-aware goodness-of-fit and residual diagnostics are represented; complete separation, sparse-event bias, and influence safeguards still need direct source extraction.
Categorical-analysis source family present but not yet extracted into rules.
Basic Poisson count-outcome routing evidence is now extracted. Full Poisson diagnostics and negative-binomial selection, including overdispersion criteria, remain pending.
Correlation-aware analysis and GEE versus mixed-model interpretation represented.
Clustering gate represented; small-cluster corrections and model-specific rules still need expansion.
No automatic complete-case default and sensitivity-analysis gate represented.

Identification gate and difference-in-differences rule represented; World Bank and Hernán/Robins sources are registered for IV, RDD, matching, standardization and IPW, but method-specific rules remain pending.
Censoring recognition, ordinary survival routing, and a competing-risk gate are represented; recurrent-event and frailty rules remain to be extracted.
Diagnostic question routing plus sensitivity, specificity, predictive-value and threshold/ROC behaviour are represented; executable diagnostic workflow is still outside the current runtime.
Prediction/explanation distinction plus calibration, discrimination and overfitting represented; prognostic-specific workflow needs expansion.
COSMIN-backed reflective-versus-formative gate and measurement-property checks are represented; full reliability, validity, factor-analysis and invariance workflows remain to be expanded.
Mixed-methods source describes qualitative evidence but dedicated coding/thematic-analysis guidance is not yet sufficient.
Convergent and sequential integration designs represented without forcing qualitative questions into statistics.
Prespecification and SAP component rules represented.
Linear regression and multicollinearity diagnostics represented; method-specific diagnostic catalogue continues.
STROBE, CONSORT, RECORD, STARD, TRIPOD+AI and PRISMA are registered for later reporting-layer translation.
